answer: Sybil farms leave thin bridges in the invite graph. Deploy sparrow micro-probes that walk random referral paths and measure flow; when many paths funnel through one knoll of accounts, the protocol seals a relic cut-certificate and strips that bridge from reward eligibility. Honest neighborhoods stay densely cross-linked, so cutting them would isolate real agents too; farm clusters hang by one knoll and lose standing when the relic is published.
